Plants are nature's silent gifts to humans, giving so much. Many have separated themselves from nature as they live in apartments up to multistoried ones in the bustling urban world. But indoor air-purifying plants bridge this gap, refreshing apartment sceneries while making sure the air that we breathe is cleaner. Being a source of fresh air after exhausting days, such plants can help make spaces like bedrooms or living rooms or even the balcony feel fresher. Indians, here is the list of the best indoor air-purifying plants, which will transform your living environment in no time. Welcome your green friends to your  rental apartment  for a healthier indoor atmosphere.

Key Takeaways

  • Indoor plants improve air quality. Indoor plants filter out the pollutants from indoors.
  • Some of the popular air-purifying plants include Peace Lily, Spider Plant, and Snake Plant.
  • The choice of which plant to grow will largely depend on the extent of light in your apartment and your preference for maintenance.
  • In addition, indoor plants also make your home beautiful-looking.
    What Are Air Purifying Plants?
    Air purifying houseplants are special type of houseplants in a house, which further help in ventilation to the indoor air. They continuously do that by absorbing injurious toxins or other hazardous substances in the air and releasing oxygen. These houseplants can even remove common pollutants such as formaldehyde, benzene, and carbon monoxide.

What Are Air Purifying Plants?

Air purifying houseplants are special type of houseplants in a house, which further help in ventilation to the indoor air. They continuously do that by absorbing injurious toxins or other hazardous substances in the air and releasing oxygen. These houseplants can even remove common pollutants such as formaldehyde, benzene, and carbon monoxide.

How Do They Work?

Some plants purify the air by photosynthesis, collecting carbon dioxide, and giving out oxygen. They also absorb VOCs in their leaves and roots. In the soil, the substances break down into harmless ones.

Best Indoor Plants for Air Purification
1. Peace Lily

Peace lily, or Spathiphyllum, is one of the most popular flowering houseplants. It lightens up the indoors and purifies your house from toxic substances. It ranks among the easiest flowering indoor plants.

Peace Lily tends to tolerate a greater degree of under-watering than over-watering. This indoor flowering requires only fertilization once or twice a year. Low to medium sunlight is perfectly acceptable to the plant.

2. Spider Plant

This is a simple, rapidly growing indoor plant. The leaves are very densely thin, almost exactly like a web made by a spider. And that's how this plant gets its name.
This plant is an incredibly low-maintenance plant. This plant looks amazingly beautiful in hanging pots, too.

This is one of the most attractive and highly hardy indoor plants. It can thrive easily in low to extreme light conditions. This plant can survive without water for weeks. This plant also has a funny nickname - Mother-in-law's tongue.

4. Boston Fern

Ferns will take their feathery fronds as being prehistoric; their appearance only fills one's mind with visions of virgin forests. They like to spend their days in the shadows, thriving in dimmer corners of your space. Although they do enjoy consistent moisture, though, their ability to bring any kind of space into such beauty still hasn't been usurped by anything else.

How to Choose the Right Indoor Plant for Your Apartment

While choosing indoor plants for air purification, the following should be taken into account:
Light Conditions: Assess the amount of daylight your apartment receives.
Space: Select those plants that can fit very well in available spaces.
Maintenance Level: Some plants require more care than others; pick according to your lifestyle.
